W5.rule: skip when a 3+-turn 5-min level is within 0.25% ahead (lookback 5 sessions)
fails: unseen: the arm no longer makes money

W20.rule: skip when a 3+-turn 5-min level is within 0.25% ahead (lookback 20 sessions)
fails: unseen: the arm no longer makes money

B5.rule: skip unless the break crossed a 3+-turn 5-min level (lookback 5 sessions)
fails: design: the arm no longer makes money
unseen: the arm no longer makes money

B20.rule: skip unless the break crossed a 3+-turn 5-min level (lookback 20 sessions)
fails: design: the arm no longer makes money
unseen: the arm no longer makes money

FX5.rule: sell when a 5-min bar closes back through the 3+-turn 5-min level the break crossed (fake breakout) (lookback 5 sessions)
fails: unseen: the arm no longer makes money

FX20.rule: sell when a 5-min bar closes back through the 3+-turn 5-min level the break crossed (fake breakout) (lookback 20 sessions)
fails: unseen: the arm no longer makes money
